svg.title: Skin diffusion: f=1e+06 Hz; sigma=5.8e+07 S/m; mu_r=1; epsilon_r=1
svg.desc: f=1e+06 Hz; sigma=5.8e+07 S/m; mu_r=1; epsilon_r=1. H0=10 A/m peak; control depth=200 micrometers. Full Maxwell solid and MQS dashed. Amplitude and real part at t=0 are distinct. Each horizontal axis is depth in micrometers.

H0=10 A/m peak; control depth=200 micrometers
